title: fMoW macro-functional superclass taxonomy
construction_principle: Classes are grouped by the primary functional domain of the depicted facility or land use. The mapping is defined without model predictions, losses, GeoBWER values, or support counts.
interpretation: Superclasses are an audit-resolution device and do not replace the original 62-class prediction task.

mobility_logistics.rationale: Aviation, ground transport, and maritime logistics infrastructure.

civic_security_services.rationale: Public-service, institutional, emergency, justice, border, and defense facilities.

settlement_commerce.rationale: Residential settlement and commercial or office land uses.

industry_energy_storage.rationale: Industrial production, energy generation or distribution, emissions, and bulk storage.

water_environment_hazard.rationale: Water bodies, hydraulic infrastructure, environmental services, and flood-related scenes.

recreation_culture_landmarks.rationale: Recreation, cultural or religious places, memorial landscapes, and landmark structures.

construction_extraction_damage.rationale: Construction, mineral extraction, and damaged or demolished built environments.
